The **Signal** group of the node palette has 10 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Convolution 1D](../signal/convolution-1d.md) | Runs | Apply a kernel to a column. |
| [FFT](../signal/fft.md) | Runs | One-sided spectrum of a column. |
| [Filter Designer](../signal/filter-designer.md) | Runs | Design and apply an FIR filter. |
| [IFFT](../signal/ifft.md) | Runs | The FFT node's table back to a signal. |
| [Ramp Signal](../signal/ramp-signal.md) | Runs | Linearly interpolate between two scalar values over a duration. |
| [Signal Scope](../signal/signal-scope.md) | Runs | Plot one connected scalar signal from the live simulation. |
| [Signal Slider](../signal/signal-slider.md) | Runs | Interactively emit one scalar value during simulation. |
| [Sine Wave](../signal/sine-wave.md) | Runs | Emit amplitude \* sin(2\*pi\*frequency\*time + phase) + offset. |
| [Step Signal](../signal/step-signal.md) | Runs | Switch from an initial scalar to a final scalar at the step time. |
| [Wavelet Transform](../signal/wavelet-transform.md) | Runs | Discrete wavelet parts of a column. |
